status: GNU/Linux x86_64 and aarch64 path stat uses the established safe wrapper. Local and native validation and review passed; integration is pending.
candidate_scope: GNU/Linux x86_64 and aarch64, 64-bit pointer width. Other targets retain their existing paths.
wrapper_evidence: Pinned rustix 1.1.5 backend/libc/fs/syscalls.rs stat uses one c::stat call for these targets, without retry or statx fallback. backend/libc/c.rs aliases stat64 as stat, and fs/types.rs aliases Stat to libc stat64. Apple-specific negative-nanosecond normalization is excluded on Linux.

libc_evidence.finding: stat64.c aliases stat and stat64 to the same implementation when XSTAT_IS_XSTAT64 is set. The default Linux kernel_stat.h sets that flag to 1; the source tree has no x86_64 or aarch64 override. This supports ordinary libc behavior, not arbitrary symbol interposition or all historic libc versions.
